text: 堆叠更多晶体管，芯片反而更冷——这一看似反直觉的结论，成为华为半导体负责人何庭波最新论文试图回答的核心问题。9月4日，何庭波在中科院科技论文预发布平台ChinaXiv发布论文《Huawei’s τ Chip Was Supposed to Melt?》（《华为的τ芯片本该过热烧毁？》），通过麒麟2026的实测数据，回应业界对3D堆叠芯片“高密度带来高功耗、高发热”的质疑。
text_en: Stacking more transistors while the chip runs cooler—this seemingly counterintuitive conclusion is the core question addressed in the latest paper by He Tingbo, head of Huawei's semiconductor division. On September 4, He Tingbo published a paper titled 'Huawei's τ Chip Was Supposed to Melt?' on ChinaXiv, the Chinese Academy of Sciences' preprint platform, using measured data from the Kirin 2026 to respond to industry skepticism about 3D-stacked chips' 'high density bringing high power consumption and high heat.'
